frozen_before: any confirmatory trial (seeds 9100..9149 never run before this file was committed)
question: Does fixed-path minimum-time speed optimisation of the recorded cartesian_gantry_v4b stage_tray path, inside the declared motor/transmission/travel/slip limits, reduce the stage_tray clock below 10.0 s without lowering stage_tray success, in the same MuJoCo model, contacts, controller, actuator limits, disturbance envelope and success criteria as the recorded V4 baseline?

clock.definition: Stage_tray attempt time is the sum of planned segment durations from idle through over_din, approach, insert, lift, carry, lower_fast, lower_seat, withdraw, rise, and idle_end.
excludes: the 0.6 s pre-contact settle of the simulation (SETTLE_S)
the 1.0 s hold after the contact phase (HOLD_S)
clock.also_reported: simulated timeline including the 1.0 s hold, and including hold plus pre-settle

baseline_law.profile: min-jerk per segment, rest to rest

optimised_law.method: fixed-path minimum-time speed optimisation, SOCP (Lipp and Boyd 2014 change of variables and exact interval time; cone epigraph), solved per rest-to-rest group
optimised_law.path: the same nominal waypoints and straight joint-space segments as the baseline; rest at every direction-changing waypoint (exact for a polyline); lower_fast -> lower_seat collinear (no forced stop)

limit_sources.rho_v: at most 0.9 of the declared top speed; belts 400 mm/s, Z 36 mm/s
limit_sources.rho_tau: planned feed-forward torque at most 50% of the actuator record; margin remains for force_scale 0.85 and the position-loop transient
limit_sources.mu_min: lowest tine/surface friction in the declared envelope [0.3, 0.6]; MuJoCo combines geom friction by maximum
limit_sources.slip_sf: declared safety factor 2 on the friction bound
limit_sources.scales: margins for declared extra plant perturbations: mass and damping +5%, Coulomb friction +10%
limit_sources.payload: tray plus kit at the high kit-mass scale, the larger of variants A and B (0.134 kg)

optimised_law.solver: CLARABEL 0.11.1 via cvxpy 1.9.3, tol_gap_abs = tol_gap_rel = tol_feas = 1e-8
optimised_law.reference: q(t) = W_k + (W_k+1 - W_k) sigma_k(t) on the SAME clipped, fork-offset waypoints as the baseline (only sigma_k and the durations differ)

controller_and_plant: Unchanged MuJoCo 3.15.0 exported scene; position actuators on the motor shafts, kp 3 N m/rad, kv 0.0045 / 0.0018 N m s/rad, forcerange equal to pull-out torque at the declared top speed (Z x 0.43), 0.5 ms implicitfast, elliptic cones, free tray and kit, no weld.

disturbance.envelope: The same declared operating envelope and identical numpy default_rng(seed) draws are used for both arms.
disturbance.extra_plant_perturbation: declared below, rng = numpy default_rng([seed, 0xE2B]), identical for both arms

success_criteria: The unchanged success criterion requires tray within 1.0 mm (xy), 1.0 deg (yaw), 0.5 mm (seat height), tilt <= 1.5 deg, kit displacement <= 1.5 mm, lift >= 8 mm, finite state, and no MuJoCo BADQACC/BADQVEL/BADQPOS warnings.

pilot.status: run before protocol freeze; development only, not analysed as confirmatory

primary_endpoint.metric: paired difference in stage_tray success proportion, optimised minus baseline, pooled over the 100 (seed, variant) pairs
primary_endpoint.uncertainty: 95 % percentile bootstrap CI resampling SEEDS (clusters of the A and B pairs that share one draw), 10000 resamples, bootstrap rng seed 20261118; exact two-sided McNemar test on discordant pairs per variant and pooled
primary_endpoint.decision: NON_INFERIOR if the lower CI bound > -0.10; INFERIOR if the upper CI bound < 0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE

secondary: requirement met per trial = success AND clock <= 10.0 s
kit displacement (paired mean difference, bootstrap CI)
tray slip in the fork frame while carried
tray settle after the commanded contact motion
slide tracking error max and RMS per phase
actuator torque peak and RMS fraction of the derated force range, saturation fraction (|tau| >= 0.999 range) per phase
mechanical positive work proxy work_J (not electrical energy)
analysis_rules: every trial is recorded and analysed, failures included; no exclusion, no re-run; an unstable simulation is a failure of that arm
not_claimed: that the 10 s requirement is physically impossible or possible on real hardware
a new feedback controller (the controller is unchanged; only the reference time law changes)

fidelity_check.result: 8 of 8 recorded V4 v4b trials (seeds 1000..1003, A and B) reproduced with identical outcome and every metric difference 0.0
